name: What is involved in a living room remodeling project with AKN Design Group?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in a living room remodeling project with AKN Design Group?

acceptedAnswer.text: A living room remodeling project with AKN Design Group begins with understanding your vision and functional needs for the space. We implement an integrated design-build process, which involves initial consultations, detailed design planning with CAD-supported layouts, material selection, and permit coordination. Our team then manages the construction, installation of new features like custom built-ins or updated flooring, and final finish work. This comprehensive approach ensures a cohesive transformation, enhancing your living room's functionality, beauty, and overall value, all managed through a single point of coordination.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our living room remodeling projects involve design planning, material selection, permit coordination, and full construction management, all handled by our integrated design-build team.
